post.description: Queue EVALUATE_COMPONENT_EXPIRY for AVAILABLE stock in the caller custody whose printed label expiry has been reached. ROLE-01 and ROLE-02 only; institution accounts require operator verification for the inventory:expiry capability. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key replays the original server evaluation time. Acceptance is not ledger commitment; poll the command status. get.description: Official cookie roles 01-03; authenticated institution only. Today's V5 source surplus per series from today's committed census and today's V5 preview forecast. UNAVAILABLE with a reason when either input is not current. SIMULATION_ONLY decision support.
Roles 01-02; ranks the authenticated supplier's PENDING requests for one series with RPS. SIMULATION_ONLY decision support; no approval follows.
Roles 01-02; BROA ranking of destinations for the authenticated institution's surplus in one series. SIMULATION_ONLY decision support; automaticApproval is always false.

UNIT_HISTORY_READ_V1 Blood Unit Transactions read. ROLE-01, ROLE-02 and ROLE-03 only; ROLE-04 and ROLE-05 receive 403. Returns custody events whose acting institution is the caller's institution, newest first by acceptedAt then transactionId (descending), with rows within one event ordered by componentId. limit counts events, not rows, so one event's units are never split across pages. A page is complete for the events it contains; the history is complete only when nextCursor is null. Reads are not cached; refresh by reading the first page again. No server-side search: clients may filter loaded rows locally and export the loaded or filtered rows to the browser-generated SIMULATION_ONLY PDF, stating that it covers the loaded rows. Label values must not be placed in URLs, query strings, logs or analytics.

ContractVersion.name: x-bloodledger-contract-version
ContractVersion.description: V2 by default. Set V2.1 to enable the additive CRYOPRECIPITATE contract; V2 behavior remains unchanged.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable replay key for this mutation. Reuse only with the identical request payload.

OperatorVerification.name: Operator-Verification
OperatorVerification.description: Two-minute, session/operator/institution/action/body/idempotency-bound grant. A consumed grant accepts only matching retries while the session remains valid.

ComponentTypeV21.description: The additive V2.1 component vocabulary. CRYOPRECIPITATE is rejected by V2.

LocalReleaseRequest.description: Exact request body for POST /local-releases. ROLE-01 and ROLE-02 only. V2.1 allows CRYO. The server freezes globally eligible FEFO members and current versions; canonical chaincode validates them before acceptance. No local-release detail read is exposed.

ReconciliationRequest.description: Exact request body for POST /reconciliation. ROLE-01 and ROLE-02 only.

ReservationActionRequest.description: The endpoint enforces an exact body by action: prepare requires preparedAt, preparedEvidenceDigest and preparedEvidenceId; compromise requires reasonCode; all other actions accept only the base fields.

reasonCode.description: compromise only; SYNTHETIC_COMPROMISE_REASONS_V1. Unlisted codes return 400 COMPROMISE_REASON_INVALID before queuing.

actionCapabilities.description: UI action visibility only. Server requires a bound PIN grant and validates roles, scope and versions.

invitationSecret.description: Returned once on issuance. Idempotent retry returns null; issue a new invitation if private delivery failed.

safeExplanation.description: Required only when reasonCode is OTHER. Synthetic, redacted explanation only.
Required only when reasonCode is OTHER. Synthetic, redacted explanation only.
Required only when reasonCode is OTHER. Synthetic, redacted explanation only.

ComponentProjection.description: Actual operational V2.1 component projection. V2 list reads omit CRYO. Purpose is read from reservation detail. institutionId is the current custodian. labelIdentity carries the recorded printed-label Donation No. for display only (LABEL_IDENTITY_READ_V1); componentId remains the record, navigation and command key. Encrypted Donation No. material (ciphertext, nonce, auth tag, key version, lookup HMAC) is never returned.

expiryState.description: Read-time comparison of the printed label expiry with the server clock and ledger status; it never changes inventoryStatus. LABEL_EXPIRED_PENDING_EVALUATION is AVAILABLE or RESERVED stock whose label expiry is at or before now; EXPIRED is ledger-evaluated; LABEL_EXPIRED_NOT_IN_INVENTORY covers other statuses past label expiry.

ExpiryEvaluationRequest.description: Exact request body for POST /components/{componentId}/expiry. ROLE-01 and ROLE-02 only. The server sets evaluationTime and eventTime; expectedVersion is the inventoryVersion that was read.

SourceSurplusView.description: TP-JOP-D07 read-only V5 source surplus per series: floor(forecast-eligible available stock - V5 point forecast - safety allowance - minimum reserve), never below zero. Explanation only.

RpsPriorityView.description: TP-JOP-D07 read-only RPS ranking of this supplier's PENDING requests for one series (INTERVIEW_DERIVED_OPTIMIZATION_V2). Explanation only; it never approves or reserves.

BroaRedistributionView.description: TP-JOP-D07 read-only BROA ranking for one series, gated by today's V5 source surplus. Candidates follow SYNTHETIC_BROA_CANDIDATES_V1 (pending needs for the series; synthetic distances). automaticApproval is always false.

LabelIdentity.description: LABEL_IDENTITY_READ_V1 display identity. Returned only to ROLE-01, ROLE-02 and ROLE-03: on GET /components and GET /components/{componentId} for components the caller's institution currently holds, and on GET /unit-history for units in the caller's institution's own ledger-committed custody events or currently held; ROLE-04/ROLE-05, reservation, transfer, census, report, audit and ledger reads do not carry it. The server decrypts the recorded Donation No. and returns it exactly as recorded for its issuer (prefixes, separators and leading zeros preserved; never reformatted). Synthetic Mediatrix labels use MMYY-MM-NNNN; other issuers use their enabled issuer policy format. One donation can yield several components that share the value: they differ by componentType and keep distinct componentId values, and the value is unique only together with issuerInstitutionId. The value is not an ISBT 128 identifier claim, is not a mutation key, and is not accepted as a server-side query filter. Clients may filter the already-authorized list locally and include it in the browser-generated SIMULATION_ONLY inventory PDF; they must not place it in URLs, query strings, logs or analytics.

value.description: Exact recorded printed-label Donation No. when status is AVAILABLE; null otherwise. Never derived from componentId, donationId, row order or fixtures.

source.description: CONFIRMED_OCR_CAPTURE for INBOUND_OCR_V1 captures; LEGACY_REGISTRATION for components registered before OCR-only intake. Null when unavailable.

unavailableReason.description: NOT_RECORDED: no encrypted Donation No. exists for this component. TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: keys, key version, decryption or the sealed read failed; no diagnostic detail is exposed. NOT_COMMITTED (GET /unit-history only): the event is not ledger-committed and the caller's institution does not hold the unit. Null when AVAILABLE.

UnitHistoryRow.description: UNIT_HISTORY_READ_V1 row: one custody event (durable V2 command) for one unit. Events from several units share transactionId; rowId is the stable row key. Rows come only from app.v2_commands, the single record behind the command timeline and audit reads, so one event never yields duplicate rows. Mockup columns: Time=eventTime, Type=direction, Scan ID=scanId, Transaction ID=transactionId, Unit ID=labelIdentity (componentId for navigation), Blood=bloodType+componentType, Method=method, Status=eventStatus, Blockchain ID=ledger.transactionId.

rowId.description: `{transactionId}:{componentId}`, or `{transactionId}:UNAVAILABLE` when unit membership is not recorded. Stable across reads.

eventType.description: INBOUND_REGISTERED: REGISTER_INBOUND_COMPONENT (confirmed OCR) or legacy REGISTER_COMPONENT. TRANSFER_RECEIVED: RECEIVE_RESERVATION, or RECEIVE_INBOUND_COMPONENT (receipt matched by an OCR capture). TRANSFER_DISPATCHED: DISPATCH_RESERVATION. LOCAL_RELEASE_COMPLETED: COMPLETE_LOCAL_RELEASE. Reservation, preparation, transit, cancellation, holds, expiry, compromise, approvals and administration are excluded.

direction.description: Relative to the caller's institution, which is always the acting custody party: registrations and receipts are INBOUND, dispatches and local releases OUTBOUND.

eventTime.description: UTC business event time recorded on the command and submitted to the ledger (within the five-minute server window, or the frozen time of an approved population run). Display in Asia/Manila. Null for legacy commands that recorded none; it is never replaced by another timestamp.

acceptedAt.description: UTC time the server durably accepted the command. Used for ordering.

transactionId.description: Business transaction ID: the durable V2 command that recorded the event. One command is one custody event and at most one ledger transaction; there is no separate transaction table to reference. Not a scan ID or a ledger transaction ID.

scanId.description: Confirmed inbound OCR capture ID (INCAP_) when the event came from a scan; null for web commands and legacy registrations.

method.description: OCR: confirmed INBOUND_OCR_V1 capture. WEB_COMMAND: authenticated Requests & Transfers action without a scan. Null: legacy registration that recorded no method.

links.description: Technical references for navigation; null when the event has none.

eventStatus.description: CONFIRMED only for COMMITTED commands. PENDING covers QUEUED, SUBMITTING and RETRY_WAIT. Only CONFIRMED represents completed inventory movement.

transactionId.description: Actual Fabric transaction ID for this event's command; null when NOT_COMMITTED. Never generated for presentation.

unitMembership.description: Reservation events take their units from the committed RESERVE_COMPONENTS/RESERVE_LOCAL_RELEASE selectedComponentIds snapshot (reallocation is disabled). UNAVAILABLE when that snapshot is missing; the row then has null unit fields.

componentId.description: Opaque component ID for row navigation and detail links.

unitAttributesSource.description: Blood and component type are fixed at registration. LEDGER_PROJECTION: read from the committed component by componentId. PENDING_COMMAND: the confirmed capture values of a registration that is not yet committed. Null when unknown.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when this page completes the history.

PolicyDisabled.description: Policy or report format is not enabled

Conflict.description: A safe identity or state conflict

Forbidden.description: The authenticated role is outside the permitted scope

CommandTimeOutOfWindow.description: V2_COMMAND_TIME_OUT_OF_WINDOW: a new command eventTime (and requestTime for transfer requests) is more than 300 seconds from the server clock. A retry with an already accepted Idempotency-Key replays the original command unchanged, and an exact operation of the active approved population manifest keeps its recorded time. On this error, discard the attempt and submit a new attempt with a new Idempotency-Key and the current time.
